{{Quote|Ship?''"<br />"''Could it be anything else?''"<br />"''Not really. Don't get vaped, but try to get past him. Make it look good.|Luke Skywalker and Jaina Solo|<ref name="Apocalypse" />}}
A '''dogfight''' took place in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] between [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], who [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the infiltration [[Starship/Legends|ship]] [[Rude Awakening (starship)|''Rude Awakening'']], and the [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]], who was under the influence of [[Abeloth]], the last surviving member of [[The Ones/Legends|the Ones]]. Unable to maneuver due to the narrow confines of the area caused by to two nearby [[Black hole/Legends|black holes]], they traded weapons fire for some time. Both vessels were damaged, but before either could be eliminated, Abeloth was finally destroyed, causing Ship to flee. Solo was able to locate [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]] on [[Abeloth's planet]], while Ship retrieved the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lady]] [[Vestara Khai]] from the surface.
